entity: US ICE field-office hold-room stays lasting over a day, Oct 2025-Feb 2026
what_we_add: 16,919 stays over 24 hours (14.8%) vs 212 (0.8%) two years earlier; Baltimore median 87 hours
why: Colorado Times Recorder reports the nationwide hold-room surge (281 to 5,011 over 72 hours); the Banner and Daily Record report Baltimore's over-limit holds. Same finding, same direction; the 24-hour national count and Baltimore median are ours.
